column8: Wed 18 Nov: 3d background for the team's prose only: none of 23 pledges names a dollar figure, so Laura naming one is the genre's real difference; say a sample picked for spread, never a share of all pledgers.

Wed 18 Nov: 3d clause beside Q99's verb test; fix the count: 4 of 14 use a verb 3d bans (Broad intention, Ellison intent, Skoll expect, Dong intention) and 2 use plan, which 3d does not ban, so never 6 of 14 use them.
Wed 18 Nov: store for 3d beside Q52-031 and Q52-032: the genre's at least is a floor on an unknown fortune; supports the existing ban, adds no new rule.
Wed 18 Nov: 3d team sentence: the genre's own proof is money already moved (9 of 23); Laura's is the Treasuries held for her before she states the figure; never that owning binds her (Q99).
Wed 18 Nov: store; the most specific pledge in the genre still names no dollars; context for row 1.

Wed 18 Nov: store, Client Knowledge for 3d: Taiwan's one pledger leads with the commitment and its vehicle; 3d's settled order opens with the ten years owned and then her figure, so not the same order; Q52-027 is Yin's sharper fixed-figure gift.
Wed 18 Nov: store; 3d's budget sits at the genre's short end; a fact for the 27 Nov writers' brief, not for the report.
Wed 18 Nov: twin of row 4 (Kim and Sul's kept promise is one of its 9); its paragraph of doubt is counted in row 1.
Wed 18 Nov: store for 3d beside Q99-036: the genre puts the done fact before a hedge; Laura's order is the promise first and the fact under it, with no hedge.

Wed 18 Nov: 3d team prose, a vivid contrast with the genre's escape clause; fix the use: by 2031 the money behind the whole stated figure ($115,000 on today's figures, both ends after the move) is held, not only the bottom; co-sponsors count the top.
Wed 18 Nov: store for 3b: set-aside stated plainly, hope only on growth; the half kept stays outside the range and is never offered to co-sponsors, as the row says.

Wed 18 Nov: store; its own count splits 3 and 3, so drop never whether it exists; and close date is the jargon this morning's voice round heard as too professional, so say the one date every pledge is paid in plain words.

Wed 18 Nov: 3d team prose (belief came from giving, not wording); fix: not the largest record in the sample, since Buffett's gifts total roughly $60bn since 2006 (Chronicle of Philanthropy, 2025, read today); say the most gifts or drop the ranking.
Wed 18 Nov: store for 3d: co-sponsors must plan around a figure, so Laura counts the money where Scott need not.
Wed 18 Nov: 3d's ask: arts-museum founders fund only what would not happen without them; the co-sponsors' share is the money still needed beside her stated top and the ten years owned.
Wed 18 Nov: store only; echoes the Taiwanese funder reader's signed only on documents, but a pledge with no amount adds nothing 3d lacks.

Wed 18 Nov: 3d's proof on request; in Laura's words never custodian (this morning's voice round heard it as fundraising jargon): say a statement from the firm that holds the Treasuries for her, sent on request.
Wed 18 Nov: store only; the Australian link earns no place, as the row says; a named place is Cryder's point (row 38).
Wed 18 Nov: store only; the 27 Nov writers read only Caplet's writing (voice programme), so never a voice sample for them; drop the letters readers remember, which no test here shows.

Wed 18 Nov: conceit store; 3d's one turn is the printed page (CONCEIT V2.3), so this is at most an alternate, read cold first; a Keel reading, so S 3; never in Laura's words or as a dig at the pledgers.
Wed 18 Nov: 3.0 or 3d team prose: the city's first reply to Ando's building was that there was no money to run it; Laura's $50,000 a year is owned first, a base, not the whole budget (H9-119).
Wed 18 Nov: store only; the residency's own yearly fundraising is cut from 3d (density row 3d); Ando's hotel interview gives about 80 firms against Nikkei BP's 85, so say about 80.
Wed 18 Nov: store for 3d's clause on who holds and runs the site: a condition on use set by the receiver.
Wed 18 Nov: 3e store beside Q77: a public precedent for one line on what happens if the project stops; Laura's money stays hers in short-term Treasuries, and the slip goes to 3e, not 3d.

Wed 18 Nov: 3.0 or 3a team prose, the strongest founder quote on the card (checked today in the Japanese interview); fix the use: Ando never calls running money the real gift, say a building is not enough without money to run it; her $50,000 a year is a base (H9-119).
Wed 18 Nov: store for 3d's shape: an author's own share in one figure with its purpose; the stele read via Chinanews, not a photograph.
Wed 18 Nov: store for 3e: a gift with no running money or terms on use drifted; the city denied the club label, so never call it a club.
Wed 18 Nov: store only, UNVERIFIED second-hand quote; never quoted until the CCTV interview is read.

Wed 18 Nov: 3.0 or 3d store, the closest analogue (a novelist founding a writers' residency); fix the use: she paid a share (about 16%, Keel arithmetic) from her compensation money while a public corporation paid the rest; the row shows neither first in time nor the site.

Wed 18 Nov: 3a reserve beside Q9c (which holds 3d's Taiwan half-clause): a famous author's residency lived on grants an evaluator cut 20%; ten years owned are not voted on; Korea, not Taiwan, and her $50,000 is a base (H9-119).
Wed 18 Nov: store only; recognition terms are cut from 3d (density row 3d).
Wed 18 Nov: store, Client Knowledge: a Taiwanese artist's seed money named by source and purpose; the prize's sum is not read.
Wed 18 Nov: store for 3d: in Taiwan the founder pays first and a named co-sponsor carries the years (with Q11e); recognition itself is cut from 3d.
Wed 18 Nov: store only, CONFLICTING (returned or donated); adds nothing 3d needs.
Wed 18 Nov: store for claim 2: the founder's share set as a condition by the receiver; a US city sale, far from 3d.

Wed 18 Nov: a dissimilar parallel for team prose at most (an artist's marble bonds against Treasuries that pay on their dates); use only the Bank Bonds sale, never the renovation total, which conflicts; never in Laura's words.
Wed 18 Nov: 3d: scale statistics lower giving even beside a story, so Laura's words carry no odds; the confidence and its arithmetic stay in 3c.
Wed 18 Nov: 3d: detail helps only when it shows what the money does; tie $115,000 to the facility and the ten years to running the residency.

Wed 18 Nov: 3d judge's aha candidate: the stories that raise most money predict repayment worst, so count what is held; read at abstract and release only, so read the paper's tables before quoting 29, 24 and 12%.
Wed 18 Nov: store for 3d beside row 39: concrete and quantitative words help, justifications hurt; state, never defend.
Wed 18 Nov: store for 3d's clarity cell: readable writing carries real information; abstract only.
Wed 18 Nov: store only; a weak cue (61%), never offered as proof, as the row says.

Wed 18 Nov: 3d's word bans have field evidence (hope to get and short of our goal mark unfunded pitches); 2.4% and even a dollar checked in the paper today; part of the phrase list is from press coverage.

Wed 18 Nov: twin of Q100-041 (Taiwan's founders had no year in hand, cold test 3.7), which is stronger and in Taiwan; Gates's own cash share is not shown (Gaps), so every founder paid first is not supported.
